svg.desc: Paid for by the Source, Reference: Across the 62 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes median real wealth by $401,312 to $1,645,529; at the main row, $441,410 (seed interval $438,882 to $444,011). Paid for by the Source, Adverse: Across the 62 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes median real wealth by $306,562 to $1,516,985; at the main row, $390,293 (seed interval $387,991 to $392,537). Paid for by the Source, Stress: Across the 62 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes median real wealth by $260,192 to $1,257,990; at the main row, $332,781 (seed interval $330,610 to $334,895). Paid for by a contribution, Reference: Across the 116 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes median real wealth by $-428,486 to $453,601; no material change in median real wealth at the main row ($17,640; materiality $20,245) (seed interval $15,370 to $19,950). Paid for by a contribution, Adverse: Across the 116 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes median real wealth by $-125,417 to $394,411; at the main row, $33,055 (seed interval $30,559 to $35,355). Paid for by a contribution, Stress: Across the 116 preregistered readings, the C2.2 design changes median real wealth by $-125,417 to $334,950; at the main row, $22,068 (seed interval $19,563 to $24,413).
svg.title: Median real wealth (weighted, year-0 dollars): the C2.2 design against no programme, 40 years
svg.text: Median real wealth (weighted, year-0 dollars): the C2.2 design against no programme, 40 years
Each dot is one preregistered reading, sorted by its effect, with its 95% seed interval (unit: $).
Ringed: the main row. Diamond: the least-favourable bound. Shaded: not material (rule 3). Below each panel: the curve's verdict (rule 2).
